title: Ford Maverick Engines by Year (1970–1977)
description: Every factory engine in the Ford Maverick car by year, 1970–1977: the 170, 200 and 250 sixes and the 302 V8, including the Grabber and Stallion models.
intro: The Maverick was Ford's compact car from 1970 to 1977, with inline sixes and, from 1971, the 302 V8. The Grabber (1970–1975) and Stallion (1976) were appearance and performance packages. The 2022-on Maverick is a pickup and is not covered here.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
Ratings are gross for 1970–1971 and SAE net from 1972. The 250 six was added during 1970, and the 170 was dropped after 1972.

excluded.researchNote: Ford's 1977 brochure says the California 302 used the variable-venturi carb. Assigning NHRA's 122 hp to it is not confirmed. Only Ford and maverick.to mention the VV version.

method: Every engine and year listed here was confirmed by at least three independent sources: the NHRA Stock Car Classification Guides, factory material such as GM Heritage Center information kits and sales brochures, EPA records and established references. Several Wikipedia articles count as one source. Where sources give different ratings, the factory figure is shown and the difference is noted. Factory race-only packages need two sources.
